50 | Light Mastery | caster | 1 rnd/lvl | varies | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster launches a flare of light that rapidly flies to a target area within
range, where it slowly drifts to the ground. For the duration of the spell,
the flare illuminates a 10' radius area. If fired at a target, it will do no
damage and simply fade away.
@@ 2
A beam of light springs from the caster’s palm. This light has a 50' effective
range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist
is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration has not
expired).
@@ 3
Target is immune to bright light, sun glare, and snow blindness. Target also
receives a special bonus of +25 versus all blinding attacks.
@@ 4
Creates 1 ball of iridescent light per caster’s level, which can be made to
“dance” anywhere within the spell’s range. These lights cannot harm, and give
off light equal to that of a torch. Everyone within sight of the lights
(except the caster) must make a RR versus a first level attack (as per a Fear
RR) or be transfixed for one round per 10% failure.
@@ 5
Lights a 10' radius area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile
object or being, it will move with the object or being. See Spell Law Section
7.1.17.
@@ 6
Creates a multi-colored display of exploding lights.
@@ 7
Creates a bright aura about the target, making him appear more powerful and
subtracting 5 from all attacks against him.
@@ 8
Causes a 10' radius burst of intense light; all those inside are stunned for 1
round per 10% failure.
@@ 9
As Light I, except has a 50' radius.
@@ 10
Caster creates and releases a sparkling ball of translucent, swirling color
which strikes the target, resulting in one round of blindness per 10% failure.
@@ 11
Causes any object up to 1000 cubic feet to glow any desired color.
@@ 12
As Aura, except subtracts 10 from all attacks.
@@ 13
As Sudden Light I, except has a 20' radius.
@@ 14
As Light I, except has a 100' radius.
@@ 15
This spell is cast in conjunction with any Light spell (i.e. the Light spell
must be cast within 1 minute of casting this spell). It can delay the
activation of that spell for up to 24 hours. It can be triggered by one of the
following (decided by the caster at the time of casting): time period,
specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent action in the area, etc.
@@ 16
A ray of light (any color) springs from caster’s palm. This ray can be up to 5
miles long.
@@ 17
As Aura, except subtracts 15 from all attacks.
@@ 18
As Light I, except has a 200' radius.
@@ 19
As Sudden Light I, except has a 50' radius.
@@ 20
As Light I, except has a 50' radius.
@@ 25
As Beacon V, except ray can be up to 10 miles long.
@@ 30
As Light I, except for area of effect.
@@ 50
Caster may use any lower level spell on this list each round for the duration
of this spell.
